title: Mellurboo's EasyVanish
description: 👻Simple and Lightweight Vanish Plugin for Admins, It's everything you need and works great in teams!
body:
## 👻 Mellurboo's EasyVanish
Easy Vanish is exactly what it claims to be, a simple, vanish plugin for admins, and thats all it is. Lightweight and easy to use, drag and drop with small settings that can be changed.

### Features Include
- Complete masking of vanished players **serverside**
- **Protection against accidents**, easily disable/enable vanished players from chatting
- Great for Collaberative Moderation with **builtin** features making it seamless!

### Unique, Admin Only Effects.
_as always, this can be disabled in config.yml_
![How other Admins will see you!](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/832877aef55009958dbcb7c064fe79a0157b0e57_0.webp)

![Our chat protections](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/6104814ec1219b16602a9045a17e1af57804d785.png)
_this can also be toggled in config.yml_

```
strings:
  youHaveVanished: "You have entered Vanish and have been removed from the Tab Menu. A disconnect message has been dispatched"
  youHaveUnVanished: "You have left Vanish players can now see you and you've been readded to the tab menu"
  # you can use %player% here, it will be replaced for you
  worldQuitMessage: "§e%player% left the game"

settings:
  glowForAdmins: true
  allowChatWhileVanished: false
```

what are you waiting for, it's way better than the essentials one ;) It's got my name on it for goodness sake
